en: Sepia-toned military postcard showing a ring of armed soldiers standing outdoors on rough ground, pointing their rifles inward toward a man lying on the ground, with another soldier standing closer to him. The scene looks staged, almost like a demonstration or a grim dance, with distant low buildings on the horizon. There is printed caption text in French at the top right margin and additional text in Greek beneath it, plus a handwritten signature-like note along the side.
